thread:
cheng: Heads-up — I have a set of cross-repo PRs that need coordinated merges today. SDK client PR (redwood-sdk#432) depends on API change (redwood-api#1981) and an infra helm bump (infra/helm#57). Who can help with approvals and an order? My suggested order: API -> SDK -> console/backend -> helm -> runtime canary finalization.

marta: Sounds right. SDK CI is green except integration tests that call staging API; they will fail until API change is merged.

alex: I can review the API PR now. I'm available for a merge/approval until 3pm PT. If we want to ship earlier, ping me.

lucas: Helm chart bump is just an image tag and values tweak. I can prepare the PR but won't merge until API is live. I'll run a dry-run once we have the image tag.

jen: Quick note — console has a tiny header serialization change to handle the new API header, I'll open a companion PR that can be merged after SDK is cut.

oncall-bot: Incident update: runtime-deploy-prod rollout at 40% (canary). Estimated finish 25m. No active incidents.

cheng: OK holding window ~30m until runtime rollout finishes. Alex, if you can land API while rollout finishes that would be ideal.

marta: I'll queue SDK merge but will only click merge after API PR is merged and a quick smoke. ping me when done.

alex: Left one tiny comment about the auth header handling — will push a fix in a minute.

alex: Pushed fix and re-ran unit tests. CI started: https://ci.internal/builds/6789 :thumbsup:

lucas: Helm dry-run looks clean locally: `helm template infra/helm --values values/prod.yaml --set image.tag=2026-03-17-abc123` no templating errors. I'll open infra/helm#58 ready-to-merge after canary.

jen: Console PR opened -> redwood-console#291. It only changes header parsing and adds one integration test. No behavioral changes expected.

cheng: Proposed merge order confirmed: (1) redwood-api#1981 (alex) -> (2) redwood-sdk#432 (marta) -> (3) redwood-console#291 (jen) -> (4) infra/helm#58 (lucas) -> (5) finish runtime canary. Anyone object?

marta: +1. I can be on merge at 11:30am PT.

paul: I'll run the smoke test once API is live and post results here.

paul: Smoke results: PASS. Quick logs: ```
200 OK /health
Auth header accepted
Integration sample requests returned expected tokens
``` logs: https://logs.internal/smoke/2901234567.txt

cheng: Nice. API merged by alex. Alex — could you do a quick patch release (minor) so SDK can point at the new API contract?

alex: Yep, cutting 0.14.1 now. Release notes: "minor header fix + auth header compatibility". Tarball and tag pushed.

marta: SDK updated to point at 0.14.1 and integration tests passing against staging. Merging SDK now.

jen: Console merged and will be deployed via canary in staging, no issues.

lucas: Helm PR merged and chart published. Will coordinate image rollout with runtime team.

cheng: Final step: finish runtime canary. @oncall-bot can you confirm the final rollout complete?

oncall-bot: runtime-deploy-prod rollout now at 100% — no errors observed.

cheng: Great — all done. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. I'll follow up with a short postmortem on any flakiness in the integration tests. :rocket:
